list.title: Work instructions

list.truncated: Only the first 500 instructions are shown: search to find the others.
list.failed: The instructions could not be read

forbidden.title: No access to work instructions
forbidden.body: This page needs the right production.instructions.view. Ask an administrator for it.

noMatch.title: No rows match these filters
noMatch.body: Change the search or clear the filters.

empty.title: No instructions yet
empty.body: Write the first one for an operation: steps, photos and videos the tablet shows at that operation.
empty.bodyView: When the production office writes one, it shows here.

tileHint.drafts: A draft waits for a second person to approve it.
tileHint.missing: The version in force lacks a language a site’s floor reads.
tileHint.unpublished: Nothing of it reaches the floor yet.
tileHint.archived: No longer shown on the floor.

archive.floor: The tablets stop showing it at once; the operation’s typed step lines, if any, take its place.
archive.kept: Its versions and who saw them stay on the record (the training record is kept).
archive.back: Restore brings it back as it was.

restore.floor: Its version in force is shown on the tablets again.
restore.twin: Refused when another instruction is in use for the same operation and style.

language.missingTitle: {language} is a floor language and is not written

new.title: New instruction
new.subtitle: An instruction belongs to one operation of the library, for every style or for one style revision.
new.operationHint: The tablets show it at this operation.
new.everyHint: Shown at this operation on every work order.
new.revisionHint: Shown first on that revision’s work orders; the others keep the one for every style.
new.copyHint: A copy takes the steps, photos and videos of an instruction in force.
new.after: It is made with version 1 as a draft: nothing reaches the floor until a second person approves it.

typed.title: Bring in the typed steps of the routings
typed.subtitle: The “[ ] CODE words” lines typed in a routing step become version 1 of an instruction for that operation and revision: a draft, so nothing changes on the floor before a second person approves it.
typed.languageHint: Their words go under this language.
typed.none: No routing step has typed step lines without an instruction.
typed.tableLabel: Routing steps with typed step lines

error.title: The instruction could not be read

notFound.title: Instruction not found
notFound.body: It does not exist, or it belongs to a company your role does not reach.

forbidden.title: No access to work instructions
forbidden.body: This page needs the right production.instructions.view. Ask an administrator for it.

record.previewHint: Opens a new tab: the version as the tablet shows it.
record.sheetHint: Opens a new tab: the paper for the station.
record.archivedBanner: {number} is archived: the tablets do not show it. Restore it to change it or show it again.

held.noManage: Writing instructions needs the right production.instructions.manage.
held.noPeople: The training record by name needs the right production.instructions.people (HR).
held.noOperations: Picking an operation needs the right product.routing.view.
held.noStyles: Picking a style needs the right product.styles.view.
held.draftExists: Version {number} is being written already: change it, or discard it first.

readOnly.PUBLISHED: Version {number} is in force: a published version never changes. Start a new version to change it.
readOnly.SUPERSEDED: Version {number} was replaced: it never changes.
readOnly.DISCARDED: Version {number} was discarded: it never changes.

held.ownDraft: Version {number} is your own draft: another person approves it (four eyes).
held.noSteps: Version {number} has no step: write at least one first.
held.noNote: Version {number} needs a change note: say what changed, for the people who saw the version before.
held.mediaNotReady_one: {count} photo or video is not uploaded yet: wait for it or take it off.

held.unsaved_one: Save the draft first ({count} change not saved).

held.offline: No connection: try again when it is back.
held.offlineBanner: No connection: what you see may be old, and nothing can be saved now.
held.notPublished: No version is in force yet.
held.nobodyNamed: Nobody can be named here: the sites’ legal basis for naming workers is not recorded.

steps.emptyBody: Add the first step: what the operator does, in the order they do it.
steps.failed: The version could not be read

noVersion.title: No version yet
noVersion.body: Start version 1 to write the steps.

steps.refused: The last save refused this step: open it to see why.
steps.codeHint: Capitals, digits, _ or - (SEAM_ALLOWANCE): the tablet ticks the step by it.
steps.iconHint: Drawn beside the step for a quick read.
steps.wordsHint: Short sentences, one action each. The tablet reads them aloud.
steps.safetyHint: Shown boxed on the tablet and the sheet. Leave it empty when there is none.
steps.criticalHint: Marked on the tablet and the sheet: a mistake here makes the garment unsafe or scrap.
steps.tickLabel: The tablet asks a tick before Finish
steps.tickHint: Finish waits until the operator ticks this step.

note.label: Change note
note.hint: What this version says new, for the people who look at it.
note.hintRequired: Needed before approval: what changed from the version before.

ack.required: Ask the operators to look at it again
ack.requiredHint: At their next Start the tablet opens this version until they tap Seen. Leave it off for a wording fix.

code.format: Step {n}: the code is 1 to 40 capitals, digits, _ or -.
code.twice: Step {n}: {code} is the code of an earlier step; each step has its own.

text.missing: Step {n}: write what the operator does in at least one language.

safety.tooLong: Step {n}: the safety note is at most {max} characters in {language}.

media.tooMany: Step {n}: at most {max} photos or videos.

caption.tooLong: Step {n}: a caption is at most {max} characters.

changeNote.tooLong: The change note is at most {max} characters.

problem.unavailable: The factory server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
problem.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.
problem.writeForbidden: Your role does not allow this change.
problem.notFound: It no longer exists, or your role does not reach it.
problem.signedOut: Your session ended: sign in again.
problem.contract: The server answered in a shape this page does not know: reload the page.
problem.rateLimited: Too many requests: wait a minute and try again.
problem.stale: Someone changed it first: reload to see it as it stands now.
problem.invalid: The server refused some fields: they are marked.
problem.sheetCompany: The sheet needs the company’s legal data (VAT number, registered office): fill them in Admin › Companies & sites.

refusal.ACTIVE_EXISTS: Another instruction is in use for this operation and style: open it instead, or archive it first.
refusal.ARCHIVED: The instruction is archived: restore it first.
refusal.DRAFT_EXISTS: A version is being written already: change it, or discard it first.
refusal.NOT_DRAFT: This version is not a draft any more: it never changes. Start a new version.
refusal.OWN_DRAFT: This is your own draft: another person approves it (four eyes).
refusal.EDITED_DRAFT: You changed this draft: a person who neither wrote nor changed it approves it (four eyes).
refusal.NO_STEPS: The draft has no step: write at least one first.
refusal.CHANGE_NOTE_MISSING: The draft needs a change note: say what changed from the version before.
refusal.MEDIA_NOT_READY: A photo or video is not uploaded yet: wait for it or take it off.
refusal.NOT_PUBLISHED: This version is not on the floor: only a version in force is acknowledged.
refusal.SEEN_ALREADY: This person acknowledged this version already: one acknowledgement per version.
refusal.DATABASE_REFUSED: The database refused the change: reload and look at the instruction as it stands.
refusal.ALREADY_EXISTS: Someone did the same at the same moment: reload and look at it as it stands.
refusal.other: The change was refused by a rule: reload and try again.

notice.published: Version {number} is in force: the tablets show it from now on.
notice.publishedSuperseding: Version {number} is in force: it replaces v{old} on the tablets from now on.
notice.archived: {number} archived: the tablets no longer show it.

media.intro_one: {count} photo or video on the steps.
media.intro_other: {count} photos or videos on the steps.
media.noFilesRead: Your role cannot open files (files.read): their names show instead.

noSteps.title: No step yet
noSteps.body: Photos and videos belong to a step: write the steps first.

media.none: No photo or video on this step.
media.caption: Caption ({language})
media.dropHint: Photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) or short videos (MP4, WebM, MOV), up to 25 MB, {max} more on this step. Never a face: show the hands and the garment.

problem.tooBig: The file is larger than 25 MB.
problem.type: Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC) and videos (MP4, WebM, MOV).

media.markupGap: Drawing on a photo comes later; mark the point in the caption meanwhile.

versions.usedInNone: No released revision uses this operation yet.

compare.failed: The versions could not be read

privacy.whoMore: HR sees the training record by name
privacy.gate: A name shows only where the site recorded the legal basis; never a figure per person

acks.failed: The acknowledgements could not be read
acks.remindHeld: Not built yet: the floor has no message for a reminder. The tablet opens a new version at Start by itself.
acks.noCurrentBody: Once a version is approved, the people who look at it on the tablet are counted here.
acks.asked: This version asks the operators to look at it: the tablet opens it at their next Start.
acks.notAsked: This version does not ask to be looked at again (a wording fix): only people who never saw the instruction are asked.
acks.noSites: No site of the company yet.
acks.seenNoSkill: {seen} saw it · nobody holds the skill here
acks.ofMeans: “of” counts the people at the site whose skills include this operation.

peopleEmpty.title: Nobody yet
peopleEmpty.body: Nobody holds the skill of this operation or saw the instruction.

acks.namesHR: Names are a training record for HR only (production.instructions.people).
acks.record: An acknowledgement is a training record (D.Lgs. 81/2008 art. 37), never a performance record.

approve.floorNotAsked: The floor shows v{number} from now on; operators who saw an earlier version are not asked again (a wording fix).

approve.same: The steps are the same as the version in force.
approve.stepApprove: Version {number} approved by a second person
approve.whoMay: Production manager or quality, never the author
approve.ruleMet: Written by {name}: you are a second person.
approve.ruleBroken: Version {number} is your own draft: another person approves it.
approve.supersedes: v{number} in force is replaced in the same moment.
approve.first: The first version to reach the floor.

newVersion.noteHint: What will change (you can write it later; it is needed before approval).

discard.title: Discard draft v{number}?

paper.dateHint: Never a day in the future.
